cues.text: On the rocks above the beach, you and Akihiko stand and Junpei crouches beside you, all looking at a wooden pier. At its far end, a girl in a long dress stands alone, gazing out at the sea.
Junpei stretches, then walks out along the pier to the girl.
Junpei stands frozen, then trudges back to you and Akihiko with his head hung and folds his arms.
Akihiko rests a hand on top of your head, then walks out along the pier to the girl.
Akihiko stands frozen, then walks back to you and Junpei.
You walk out along the pier to the girl, while Junpei and Akihiko watch from the rocks.
You say something to her, too quietly to hear. She turns to face you.
She dashes away past you and runs off. You turn to watch her go, and Junpei and Akihiko come out to join you.
